channel.title: The Inference Index · compute.world
channel.description: Token APIs and inference endpoints, as the operator publishes them. China and the EU stay on the list even when the city is sales-gated. This is not a bare-metal catalog, and it is not a market cap. Snapshot 2026-08-19. 21 providers. Not a market cap.

item.title: Groq / GroqCloud · inference
item.description: Groq / GroqCloud (inference). HQ Mountain View · United States. 11 sourced location rows. Cities: 11 named. Groq LPU, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX announced, Llama and other open models via GroqCloud — catalog rotates. Official page says 13 DCs across four continents but lists 11 named sites. Remaining two cities unpublished.
